# B"H

<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Candidate Browser Failure Evidence

> The Awtsmoos distinguishes a promising source experiment from a browser-proven release;
> Awtsmoos.com preserves every local vessel while refusing promotion without living peace.

## Candidate Identity

The audited working tree contains a coherent uncommitted Mitzvah World experiment whose local compact artifact is:

- Bytes: `5,169,833`.
- SHA-256: `0bb7ad67af0964e5426492beb082f54ecb2fb5dd9aaee28bc1c304a1538f43c4`.
- Production was not changed during this audit.

## Green Source Evidence

- Syntax checks passed for the changed runtime, UI, readiness, minimap, multiplayer, diagnostic, and compact files.
- Twenty-seven focused tests passed.
- Passing areas included frame scheduling, feature scheduling, readiness identity, terrain readiness, friendly NPC scheduling, route shell, minimap, and native boot contracts.

## Red Promotion Evidence

### CompactJS architecture proof

`compactJs.mitzvahWorldRuntime.test.js` rejected the compiled candidate because the generated graph does not contain the folded `scheduleMinimalMeadowFeatures` implementation.

The emitted candidate compact artifact contains:

```text
const FEATURE_SCHEDULER_URL = resolveDeferredAppModuleUrl(...)
const module = await import(FEATURE_SCHEDULER_URL)
return module.scheduleMinimalMeadowFeatures(...)
```

The essential scheduler is therefore outside the compact execution graph.

### Isolated browser proof

A fresh local Python server and isolated headless Chrome profile served the current working tree directly with cache disabled. The audit allowed the candidate a full two-minute observation window and used a thirty-second CDP evaluation budget.

The renderer did not answer `Runtime.evaluate` within thirty seconds. The terminal error was:

```text
CANDIDATE_CDP_TIMEOUT:Runtime.evaluate
```

This prevented proof of diagnostics publication, essential readiness, playable state, six-system availability, minimap ownership, chat mounting, or movement.

## Comparison With Proven Production

The active production release `d77341824c15c8ef696d8b5b59ed5da0049bc78d` previously reached playable state in approximately `11.138` seconds with all six systems, zero relevant browser/network errors, and verified movement.

The candidate did not reach a measurable playable milestone within the audit window.

## Safety Result

- Candidate source files were not rewritten.
- The compact artifact was not regenerated.
- No files were staged.
- No commit, push, or deployment occurred.
- Unrelated Android, Tanach search, movie-studio, browser-harness, and deployment-snapshot work remained untouched.
